name: President Donald J. Trump International Airport (formerly Palm Beach International)

runway.v: three runways in the FAA AIP: 10L/28R 10,001 ft x 150 ft (about 3,048 m x 46 m), 14/32 6,931 x 150 ft, 10R/28L 3,214 x 75 ft; runway 10R/28L is not available for scheduled air carriers with more than 9 seats or unscheduled ones with 31 seats or more

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft 7 days a week 09:00–19:00 (office hours 08:00–20:00 Eastern Time); contact CBP at least 4 hours before leaving the foreign port; FIS facility on its own ramp, not attached to an FBO or the terminal

hours.v: airport attended all months, all days, all hours (FAA AIP); the County also states a 24-hour control tower
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

handling.v: the County's general aviation page says three fixed-base operators but lists four names: Atlantic Aviation, Jet Aviation, Signature Flight Support and NetJets
handling.quote: has a choice of three fixed-base operators

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement procedures from a Part 150 study; no penalty for not using them; the page gives no hours or procedure details
noise.quote: there is no penalty for failing to utilize noise abatement procedures.

ppr.v: 24 hours' prior permission for aircraft with a wingspan over 171 ft; no general PPR for smaller aircraft is stated in the FAA AIP
ppr.quote: 24 HR PPR FOR ACFT WITH WINGSPANS GTR THAN 171 FT.

max_aircraft.v: aircraft with a wingspan of 118 ft or more may not use taxiway L, nor taxiways E, W, Y and F north-west of taxiway A; over 171 ft needs 24 hours' PPR
max_aircraft.quote: AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN OF 118 FT OR GREATER IS PROHIBITED ON TWY L.
